newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Underwear buried in alleged Satanic rite.
newsitem.headline: Underwear buried in alleged Satanic rite.

text.p: An 18-year-old youth was arrested as he buried women's lacy black underwear in a Colombian cementery as part of an alleged Satanic ritual, police said on Thursday.
The young man was seized in a suburb of the Caribbean coastal city of Barranquilla late on Wednesday and police said he was the head of a sect of devil worshippers.

Police offered little evidence to back up their claims of Satanism except to say the youth was dressed "entirely in black". Six other people who were taking part in the rite escaped among the tombstones, a police spokesman said.
The arrest brought a warning from the authorities to be on the look out for other devil worshippers during Easter week -- the holiest period of the Christian calendar.
